title: Color Collision
description: Match the colors and avoid crashing in this fast-paced game.
about:
Color Collision is a browser game where you change the center balls to the color needed to survive the incoming collisions. Keep matching as the pace increases.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Change the center balls to the color needed to survive the incoming collisions. Keep matching as the pace increases.
tips: Use click / tap to switch the center color.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Color Collision?
faq.answer: Change the center balls to the color needed to survive the incoming collisions. Keep matching as the pace increases.

faq.question: Can I play Color Collision in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
